import pandas as pd
trips = tables['trips']
t2 = trips[trips['fish_date_season']==2]
out = {}
out['n_trips_s2'] = len(t2)
out['doy_range'] = (int(t2['fish_date_doy'].min()), int(t2['fish_date_doy'].max())) if len(t2) else None
if len(t2):
    g = t2.groupby('cls').agg(anglers=('anglers','sum'), yt=('yt','sum'), n=('cls','size'))
    g['ypa'] = g['yt']/g['anglers']
    out['by_class'] = g.to_dict('index')
    doybuck = (t2['fish_date_doy']//10*10)
    g2 = t2.groupby(doybuck).agg(anglers=('anglers','sum'), yt=('yt','sum'))
    g2['ypa'] = g2['yt']/g2['anglers']
    out['by_doy10'] = g2.to_dict('index')

climate = tables['climate']
out['climate_latest'] = climate.sort_values('avail_t').tail(6)[['index_id','value','avail_doy']].to_dict('records')

pier = tables['pier']
out['pier_latest'] = pier.sort_values('ts_t').tail(3)[['wtmp_c','ts_doy']].to_dict('records')
# pier trend last 20 days avg
recent = pier[pier['ts_doy']>=40]
out['pier_recent_mean'] = round(recent['wtmp_c'].mean(),2) if len(recent) else None

fd = tables['fishdope']
out['fishdope_latest'] = fd.sort_values('avail_t').tail(3)[['report_date_doy','yt_all','yt_local','wt_all']].to_dict('records')

sched = tables['schedule']
s2 = sched[(sched['fish_date_season']==2) & (sched['fish_date_doy']>=60) & (sched['fish_date_doy']<=80)]
out['schedule_upcoming_by_cls'] = s2['cls'].value_counts().to_dict()

result = out
